title: HANDOFF CoS: demo-web whole project to Claude Code (PR #3 first, wave 13 ungated)
description:
# demo-web -- Claude Code CoS takeover

You are the chief of staff for the demo-web project, starting at PR #3.
You are picking this up brand new.

Do **not** write product code directly in `demo-org/demo-web`. Coding stays
with the assigned coder via beads. You packet, gate, merge-while-draft,
resolve threads, mark ready for one review pass, and request final review
only when that pass is clean on the **current** head.

Re-read beads, git, and the PR before you act. This file is a snapshot; if
disk disagrees, disk wins.

Parent bead `demo-fleet-78jr` is still assigned to a peer. Take it if you own
CoS for this handoff.
acceptance_criteria:
1. PASS/FAIL: claimed this bead; re-read 78jr, 78jr.9, x2l4, and PR #3 from disk/GitHub, not from the file alone.
2. PASS/FAIL: independently gated+merged wave 13 while draft, OR filed a red-gate coder bead with the FAIL log.
3. PASS/FAIL: either review is clean on the new head and the next round requested, OR PR converted back to draft with the next wave bead in flight.
4. PASS/FAIL: no merge to main, no deploy, no review request while LIVE on-head threads exist.
5. PASS/FAIL: this bead closed only when review_loop.sh close is 0 OR a later CoS handoff bead exists with the current head SHA.

title: demo-web: BOOTSTRAP DEADLOCK -- the staff registry can never be populated, so nothing can ever be approved
description:
The first-run flow requires an approved staff record to create the first
staff record -- a genuine bootstrap deadlock with no seed path. Fixed by
adding a one-time bootstrap-super-admin path gated on the registry being
genuinely empty, logged loudly, and disabled the moment one real admin
exists.
